5. Multiple independent paths ([32+,35-,32+ variant], [18+,35-]) all failed to surpass this candidate, and every 3-feature extension degraded it — convergent evidence that the 2-feature rule was a stable local optimum rather than a fluke.
6. Stopped on a failure trigger and submitted **rule [33+, 35-]** as the final candidate.
